day_shape: 89 items: IRGC claims four tankers damaged in eastern Strait of Hormuz including one struck by naval mine, ninth MQM-170 drone said captured, Rubio condemns Iran's attacks on Bahrain, France pushes EU sanctions over alleged IRGC refrigerator hacks.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz tanker incidents
threads.summary: IRGC Navy said a fourth non-compliant tanker in 24 hours was damaged in the eastern Strait of Hormuz after striking a naval mine, and IRIB cited UKMTO reporting a tanker attacked 7nm north of Khabb, Oman lost power with an engine-room fire. USS Theodore Roosevelt was reported transiting the Indian Ocean into CENTCOM's area.

threads.label: IRGC claims against US aircraft and drones
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB claimed a ninth American MQM-170 drone was captured via electronic warfare in southern Iran, and Defa Press ran a series on an F-35 shot down during the 40-day war and an F-15 said to have been downed by a specialised air defence system. Defa Press also listed "refuted" claims including Trump's assertion that 99% of Iran's missiles were intercepted.

threads.label: US diplomacy on Iran and Gulf partners
threads.summary: Secretary Rubio spoke with Bahraini FM Al Zayani and condemned Iran's attacks on Bahrain, while Trump said he plans to raise Iran with Xi and Putin and deflected a question on whether he wants China to stop buying Iranian oil. Iran International cited Military Times reporting the US Army is seeking contractors for 17 reinforced bunkers in Israel, Saudi Arabia and Lebanon.

threads.label: Gaza strikes and Nasser Hospital identifications
threads.summary: The IDF named Hamas operatives killed in Thursday's Nasser Hospital strike, including an October 7 participant tied to the abduction of Adina Moshe, and announced five Hamas operatives killed in recent Gaza strikes plus demolition of a 300-metre tunnel on the Israeli side of the Yellow Line. A UN ambassadors' delegation toured a Hamas tunnel in Gaza with Israel's envoy Danny Danon.

threads.label: Lebanon and Syria border operations
threads.summary: The IDF said it apprehended two members of the Hezbollah-allied Lebanese Resistance Brigades in Shebaa and struck a Hezbollah weapons shipment moving from Syria into Lebanon, while JPost reported France advancing a plan to deploy troops for joint patrols with the LAF. Defa Press claimed Israeli military vehicles entered al-Rafid village near Quneitra and that Israeli jets struck Houla in southern Lebanon.

threads.label: Iraq confronts Iran-backed militias
threads.summary: JPost reported Iraqi PM Ali al-Zaidi moving against Iran-backed militias and a crackdown on an alleged oil-smuggling network linked to Kataib Hezbollah. Defa Press reported a drone strike on a hideout of Iranian anti-regime groups in Sulaymaniyah and IRIB said an alarm was activated at the Khor Mor gas field.

threads.label: Iran domestic strain and intelligence penetration
threads.summary: JPost reported worsening winter gas shortages in Iran after US strikes on energy plants, and Iran International quoted a senior IRGC commander acknowledging extensive Israeli intelligence infiltration of Iranian military and government institutions. JPost also reported Isfahan air defences activated according to Iranian media, and France seeking EU sanctions over alleged IRGC cyberattacks on supermarket refrigerators.

The tunnel was located during operations by the military's Harel Brigade in the area. The IDF says the demolition comes as part of an ongoing effort to destroy Hamas's tunnels and other infrastructure in the territory of the Strip held by Israel.

events.title: The IDF confirms striking a weapons shipment destined for Hezbollah in eastern Lebanon overnight. In a statement, the military says the Israeli Air Force bombed the shipment of weapons in the Janta area in Lebanon's Beqaa Valley, close to the Syrian border, after it had been transferred from Syria into Lebanon, en route to Hezbollah. "The weapons were intended to strengthen Hezbollah's operational capabilities to carry out terror attacks against Israeli civilians and IDF troops," the military says. The IDF says that the Janta area has been used by Hezbollah to conduct "numerous weapons shipments" in the past.

Lebanon's National News Agency reports that the troops raided and searched the home of the two men, who are brothers, "ransacking its contents and damaging belongings," before taking the pair away and leaving the area. The IDF has not yet commented on the reports.

events.title: The Israeli Air Force carried out a rare strike in Lebanon's eastern Beqaa Valley overnight, Lebanese media reports. The strike reportedly hit an area near the Lebanon-Syria border. According to Israeli security sources, the strike was intended to thwart a weapons shipment destined for Hezbollah in Lebanon. It marks the first Israeli strike in the area in several months. The IDF has not commented on the reports.
